semantics: The 9 December 2009 action concerns Macedonian Chrysostom/Basil translations. The official register calls it approval; SICO records recognitio. An exact printed book, operative use and complete native contents remain unestablished. Reported titles and years below are unauthenticated discovery leads, potentially spanning two rites; they are neither active nor deferred candidates and have no chronology coordinates.

checked_source_loci.loci: Register physical line 41; SICO PDF page 290 / printed 291
checked_source_loci.judgment: The online register calls the 9 December action approval; SICO's recognitio heading governs the Macedonian Chrysostom/Basil bullet. The packet preserves that distinction. Neither source identifies a printed title, imprint, contents or actual use.

The complete pastoral letter calls upon clergy to celebrate with the people on Sunday 3 December 2023 in thanksgiving. It is not a report establishing occurrence, language or a book. Promoting the old unopened audit lead to inspected while preserving its stable ID is justified.

Official article identifies the title 25 години епископство на монсињор Стојанов, authors Goce Kostov and Zoran I. Stojanov, and 5 September 2024 presentation. It describes the bishop serving two ecclesiastical jurisdictions with two rites. It does not print a liturgical-book list or authenticate the Scribd extract.

checked_source_loci.loci: Displayed publication subsection, derived lines 245–250, checked against the retained public response
checked_source_loci.judgment: Accept retention of this source as an explicitly unauthenticated discovery lead. The displayed six titles and years are useful next targets, but no original monograph page, source-book title leaf, imprint, rite, approval or use is authenticated. This is not a textual exemplar or a basis for publishing source wording. No active or deferred candidate is justified yet.

uses.next_evidence: Obtain publicly reachable original pages of the 2024 jubilee monograph's Издаваштво / Литургиски книги section, then the reported 2009 Литургикон title, imprint, approval and contents leaves; establish its Greek or Church Slavonic exemplar and a dated implementation or use record tied to that exact book.
uses.limitation: The 2023 request to celebrate does not establish that celebration occurred or identify its language, edition or use of the 2009 wording. The official 2024 monograph report authenticates a research target, not the third-party extract.

sources.locus: HTML lines 864–881, especially line 876; extracted derivative lines 209–225. Vatican News publication timestamp 4 December 2023, 08:27.
sources.limitation: The bishop invites clergy to celebrate thanksgiving liturgies on 3 December 2023. This is a requested celebration, not a report proving celebration, language, exact celebrant edition, source-language exemplar, or reception of the 2009 approved wording. The provider's whole HTML is retained only in disposable research scratch; no permission for Git redistribution was established.

sources.locus: HTML lines 864–886: monograph title and authors at 865, authors' media work at 875, described scope at 876, printer acknowledgement at 884. Report published 6 September 2024, 13:29; presentation event 5 September 2024.
sources.limitation: Verifies the existence, title, named authors Goce Kostov and Zoran I. Stojanov, and presentation of the episcopal jubilee monograph. It neither reproduces the monograph's liturgical-book list nor identifies a 2009 altar-book imprint. The report's description of 15 thematic chapters and more than 250 photographs is not a contents census of any service book. The provider's whole HTML is retained only in disposable scratch; no permission for Git redistribution was established.

sources.locus: Displayed document labelled 12, advertised as six pages; subsection Издаваштво / Литургиски книги; extracted derivative lines 181–250, target list at 245–250. No trustworthy original monograph page locus established.
sources.limitation: Discovery lead only: uploader provenance is unauthenticated and the page asserts all rights reserved. The apparent extract lists Литургикон (2009), Евангелие и Апостол за литургиската година (2009), Обредник (2009), Божествена литургија за народот (2010), Тропари и кондаци (2022), and Велигденско тродневие (2020). Neither the years, imprint, rite of each title, exact contents, approval, nor actual use has been verified from original books. Bishop Stojanov's dual Latin and Byzantine jurisdiction prevents assigning every title to the Byzantine route. Keep as followup evidence only; no active or deferred catalogue candidate or stage is proposed from this list. The whole public response is scratch-only, and neither its bytes nor its source text is cleared for Git redistribution.
